_meta.authored_by: aaroh_ai (seeded defaults) — NOT an agronomist sign-off
review_required: PER-CROP RDF (rdf_kgha): these are generic Indian recommended doses, NOT Chambal/MP-specific. mishr to supply/validate authoritative RDF per the 'you provide the dose table' decision.
CLASS MULTIPLIERS (Low=1.25, Medium=1.0, High=0.0): the High=0 rule is what makes a nutrient 'sufficient -> add nothing'; confirm this is the intended Low/Med/High response.
LEGUME N-RDF set to 0 (Chickpea, Arhar, Moong, Urad, Soybean, Groundnut fix atmospheric N; starter N omitted in v1). Confirm whether a starter dose (~20 kg N/ha) is wanted.

SOIL-TEST RATING THRESHOLDS (soil_rating): standard ICAR class limits on an ELEMENTAL kg/ha basis (N 280/560, Olsen-P 10/25, K 110/280). The 7-in-1 probe reports a PROXY, not a wet-chemistry available-nutrient value -- hence the standing 'npk_proxy_uncalibrated' warning until per-device calibration exists.
PRICES (inr_per_bag): provisional retail; verify against local Chambal dealer MRP.

BAG SIZE: v1 models ALL products as 50 kg bags to match the frozen RecommendationResult field 'bags_50kg'. In reality urea is sold in 45 kg bags. Decide: keep 50 kg notional, or evolve the contract to per-product bag sizes.
ROUNDING: whole bags via round-half-up (nearest). Decide nearest vs round-up (round-up guarantees adequacy but over-applies).

factors._note: mgkg_to_kgha: mg/kg -> kg/ha assumes bulk density 1.3 g/cm3 over 15 cm depth (guide locks 1.95 over the 2.0 rule of thumb). USED in v1: converts probe mg/kg to the kg/ha basis the soil_rating limits use. p_to_p2o5 / k_to_k2o (the 'oxide trap' constants, elemental P->P2O5 x2.291, elemental K->K2O x1.205) are RESERVED: they are NOT on the class-based v1 number path (RDF is already stated as oxide N-P2O5-K2O and products are graded as oxide, so dose->product needs no conversion). They exist here as the single source of truth for the ICAR-STCR targeted-yield equation that will replace dose_model later, where requirement and soil-supply must be reconciled in one unit.

products._note: Grades are standard: Urea 46-0-0, DAP 18-46-0, MOP 0-0-60 (N-P2O5-K2O). Allocation order: DAP meets P2O5 (crediting its N), Urea meets residual N, MOP meets K2O. real_bag_kg for urea is 45 in the market; see review_required.

soil_rating._basis: ELEMENTAL kg/ha, matching how Indian soil-test ratings are quoted. classify.py converts the probe's elemental mg/kg to kg/ha (x mgkg_to_kgha) and compares directly to these limits -- NO oxide conversion in the class-based v1 (that would misclassify: the P<10 figure is elemental Olsen-P, not P2O5). value < low_max => Low; value < med_max => Medium; else High. N: alkaline-KMnO4 available N. P: Olsen available P (elemental). K: ammonium-acetate available K (elemental).

dose_model._note: dose(crop, nutrient) = rdf_kgha[crop][nutrient] x class_multiplier[soil_class_of_that_nutrient]. Each nutrient uses its OWN soil class. This is the deterministic, class-based v1; an ICAR-STCR targeted-yield equation can replace this block later without touching product allocation / cost.
